cases.title: gateway condition: bare missing variable (default flow present)
cases.docs: 8.9 conditions: a condition that does not evaluate to true is not taken; the gateway takes its default flow (or raises an incident when there is none) — measured on live Zeebe 8.5. The diagram always has TWO outgoing flows: flowA carries the case condition, flowB is the default flow (defaultFlow=true) or a never-taken conditioned flow '=false' (defaultFlow=false)

cases.title: source without '=' that looks like a number — static STRING or a number value?
cases.docs: 8.9 expressions: without '=' the source is a static value, not FEEL — the value keeps its TEXT form (measured live on Zeebe 8.5: source '42' → the string "42", not the number 42)

cases.title: source without '=' that looks like JSON — static STRING or a parsed object?
cases.docs: 8.9 expressions: without '=' the source is a static value, not FEEL; a JSON text is not parsed implicitly (measured live on Zeebe 8.5: source '{"a":1}' → the string "{\"a\":1}")

cases.title: source without '=' with surrounding spaces — trimmed or verbatim?
cases.docs: 8.9 expressions: without '=' the source is a static value, not FEEL; the value is the source text VERBATIM (measured live on Zeebe 8.5: source '  hello  ' → the string "  hello  ", spaces kept)

cases.title: OUTPUT source without '=' — a static value too?
cases.docs: 8.9 variables: an output mapping source is an EXPRESSION; live Zeebe 8.5 refuses the model at DEPLOY ("Expected expression but found static value 'hello'. An expression must start with '='")

cases.title: OUTPUT source without '=' that names a variable — refused at deploy too?
cases.docs: 8.9 variables: an output mapping source is an EXPRESSION; live Zeebe 8.5 refuses the model at DEPLOY ("Expected expression but found static value 'present'. An expression must start with '='") — the variable of the same name does not make it an expression

cases.title: MI inputCollection written as a static value (no '=')
cases.docs: 8.9 multi-instance: inputCollection is a FEEL expression — without '=' it is a static value and live Zeebe 8.5 refuses the model at deploy (probe mi-inputcollection-noeq)

cases.title: MI outputElement written as a static value (no '=')
cases.docs: 8.9 multi-instance: outputElement is a FEEL expression — without '=' it is a static value and live Zeebe 8.5 refuses the model at deploy (probe mi-outputelement-noeq)

cases.title: MI outputElement as a JSON text without '=' (the production corpus spelling)
cases.docs: 8.9 multi-instance: outputElement is a FEEL expression — the production corpus writes it without '=', which live Zeebe 8.5 reads as a static value and refuses at deploy (probe mi-outputelement-json)

cases.title: MI outputElement as a bare reference to a PROCESS-level variable — the legal form of the production spelling
cases.docs: 8.9 multi-instance: the output element is a FEEL expression; a bare identifier is pre-created as NULL in the MI scope (F1 root 6), so the process-level value is shadowed — live 8.5 probe mi-outputelement-eq-var: results [null, null]

cases.title: MI outputElement as a CONTEXT that reads a process-level variable
cases.docs: 8.9 multi-instance: a context expression is NOT pre-created, so the process-level value stays visible — live 8.5 probe mi-outputelement-eq-ctx-var: results [{v: P}, {v: P}]
